description: 收集自 start_coverage 以来累积的 JS 执行覆盖率，报告实际运行过的函数，按脚本分组并按调用次数排序。返回相对上一次 get_coverage 调用的增量。

maxFunctionsPerScript.description: Maximum executed functions to list per script (default: 40).

maxScripts.description: Maximum number of scripts to report (default: 30).

stop.description: Stop and disable coverage after collecting (default: false).

urlFilter.description: Only include scripts whose URL contains this substring.

name: get_coverage
